local-conversations.name: local_conversations_read_attachment
local-conversations.title: Read a local conversation attachment
local-conversations.description: Extract text from an inline attachment in a local conversation. Use the conversation id, message id, and filename shown by the conversation tool. HTTP attachments are not supported.

messageId.description: Id of the message containing the attachment

local-conversations.name: local_conversations_delete_conversation
local-conversations.title: Delete local conversation by id
local-conversations.description: Delete a local conversation by id.

local-conversations.name: local_conversations_search_text
local-conversations.title: Search local conversations (text only)
local-conversations.description: Plain text search across local conversations. Searches only text parts. Multi-word queries match when all words occur in the same text part, regardless of order or distance.

query.description: Search query. Single words use substring match; multi-word queries require every word in the same text part.

skill-search.name: search_skills
skill-search.title: Search skills
skill-search.description: Searches the available Agent Skills catalog by skill id, name, description, origin, and version. Use this only when the user-enabled Skill search plugin is available and you need to discover a skill for the current task. Send concise keyword queries only, not natural-language requests or prompts. Good queries look like 'excel spreadsheet csv formulas' or 'pdf extract summarize'. Activate a returned skill with activate_skill using its exact id/skill_id before following its instructions.

query.description: Keyword-only search terms for the needed capability, separated by spaces. Do not send full prompt-style questions such as 'find a skill that can help me with spreadsheets'; send 'spreadsheet excel csv' instead. Multiple keywords are ranked by coverage and relevance. If omitted, returns the first catalog entries.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching skills to return. Defaults to 10 and is capped at 50.

skill-search.name: activate_skill
skill-search.title: Activate an enabled skill
skill-search.description: Loads the body instructions for an enabled agent skill. Use this when one of the available skills matches the current task. After activation, use read_skill_resource to load referenced bundled files by relative path.

skill_id.description: Exact enabled skill ID string to activate. Use the id/skill_id shown in the system context or returned by search_skills; do not invent IDs.

skill-search.name: read_skill_resource
skill-search.title: Read a bundled skill resource
skill-search.description: Reads a bundled file from an enabled skill by relative path. Use this after activate_skill when the skill instructions reference scripts, references, or assets. Paths are relative to the skill root.

skill_id.description: Exact enabled skill ID string that owns the resource. Reuse the same id/skill_id passed to activate_skill.

path.description: Relative path within the skill directory, for example references/REFERENCE.md or scripts/run.py.

local-artificial-intelligence.name: local_ai_providers_list
local-artificial-intelligence.title: List local AI providers
local-artificial-intelligence.description: List providers from the local runtime provider catalog.

country.description: Optional provider country filter (exact ISO country code match, case-insensitive), e.g. NL.

inferenceRegion.description: Optional inference region filter (exact token match, case-insensitive). Allowed values: World, Europe, Americas, Asia, Africa, Oceania.

limit.description: Optional max number of providers to return.

local-artificial-intelligence.name: local_ai_provider_countries_list
local-artificial-intelligence.title: List local AI provider countries
local-artificial-intelligence.description: List the unique ISO country codes represented in the local runtime provider catalog, including the number of providers for each country.

local-artificial-intelligence.name: local_ai_providers_search
local-artificial-intelligence.title: Search local AI providers
local-artificial-intelligence.description: Search providers in the local runtime provider catalog by key or display name.

query.description: Search text matched case-insensitively against provider key and name.

country.description: Optional provider country filter (exact ISO country code match, case-insensitive), e.g. NL.

inferenceRegion.description: Optional inference region filter (exact token match, case-insensitive). Allowed values: World, Europe, Americas, Asia, Africa, Oceania.

limit.description: Optional max number of providers to return.

local-artificial-intelligence.name: local_ai_models_search
local-artificial-intelligence.title: Search local AI models
local-artificial-intelligence.description: Search models from local app state by id, name, type, owner, tags, provider id, and provider name.

provider.description: Optional provider filter by provider key or display name.

type.description: Optional model type filter (e.g. language, image, speech).

limit.description: Max number of models to return.

local-artificial-intelligence.name: local_ai_models_list_by_provider
local-artificial-intelligence.title: List local AI models by provider
local-artificial-intelligence.description: List local app-state models by provider, with optional model type filter.

limit.description: Optional max number of models to return.

local-images.name: local_mask_create
local-images.title: Create mask file
local-images.description: Create a PNG alpha mask for image editing. Transparent = edit allowed, opaque = keep original.

boxes.description: Rectangular edit regions (transparent holes). An empty array keeps the entire image opaque.

local-images.name: local_images_list
local-images.title: List saved images
local-images.description: List Images library references and model/date metadata, without image data. Local files are discoverable with local_files_list. Use the references to read, ask questions about, or refine images.

local-images.name: local_images_read
local-images.title: Read saved image
local-images.description: Read an image from the Images library or Local files. Image content sent back to AI respects the user's tool-output settings. Use local_images_ask to ask a vision model a specific question instead.

image.description: A real saved image, never a placeholder. Source 'images' uses an Images library item ID and zero-based imageIndex; source 'files' uses a Local file ID (or exact unique filename).

imageIndex.description: Images library: zero-based index, null defaults to 0. Local files: use null (0 also accepted).

local-images.name: local_images_generate
local-images.title: Generate or refine images
local-images.description: Generate images through the dedicated images API, not Responses. For a NEW image use inputImages: [] and mask: null; never invent a mask/file ID. Saves results to the Images library (Local files fallback) and returns reusable references. To refine, supply saved inputImages; a PNG alpha mask is optional even when refining. Discover exact provider-qualified image model IDs with local_ai_models_search (type image). Null or omitted generation options use the user's image settings. Use local_images_ask on a returned reference to check the result, then call this tool again to refine it. Image tool output respects user settings.

model.description: Exact provider-qualified image model ID from the local model catalog, e.g. openai/gpt-image-1, not bare gpt-image-1.

items.description: A real saved image, never a placeholder. Source 'images' uses an Images library item ID and zero-based imageIndex; source 'files' uses a Local file ID (or exact unique filename).

imageIndex.description: Images library: zero-based index, null defaults to 0. Local files: use null (0 also accepted).

inputImages.description: Use [] or null to create a new image. Only provide actual saved references for editing.

anyOf.description: A real saved image, never a placeholder. Source 'images' uses an Images library item ID and zero-based imageIndex; source 'files' uses a Local file ID (or exact unique filename).

imageIndex.description: Images library: zero-based index, null defaults to 0. Local files: use null (0 also accepted).

mask.description: Use null for no mask, especially for NEW images. Only supply a real PNG alpha mask reference for masked editing with inputImages. Never use an ID like 'none'.

local-images.name: local_images_ask
local-images.title: Ask questions about images
local-images.description: Ask a vision-capable language model a question about saved Images library or Local file images through the normal Responses API. Returns only the answer as text; does not generate images or invoke tools. Use to inspect a generated image before refining it. This explicitly sends selected images as model input, independently of the setting that filters images returned in tool output. Discover language models with local_ai_models_search.

model.description: Exact provider-qualified vision-capable language model ID from the catalog.

items.description: A real saved image, never a placeholder. Source 'images' uses an Images library item ID and zero-based imageIndex; source 'files' uses a Local file ID (or exact unique filename).

imageIndex.description: Images library: zero-based index, null defaults to 0. Local files: use null (0 also accepted).

modelId.description: Model ID to use for the agent. For example: 'openai/gpt-5-mini' or 'openai/gpt-5.2'

mcpServerUrls.description: List of MCP servers attached to this agent

policyReadOnly.description: Whether the agent is restricted to read-only operations

policyOpenWorld.description: Whether the agent can query external/unknown resources

policyDestructive.description: Whether the agent can make destructive changes

local-agents-editor.name: local_agents_list
local-agents-editor.title: List local Agents
local-agents-editor.description: List the names and descriptions of all local AI Agents available. Local agents are Microsoft Agent Framework agents that the user can run in this chat app.

local-agents-editor.name: local_agents_get
local-agents-editor.title: Get local Agent
local-agents-editor.description: Get the complete configuration of one local AI Agent by its exact name.

local-agents-runtime.name: local_agents_run
local-agents-runtime.title: Run Agent Framework agent
local-agents-runtime.description: Call a local or remote Agent Framework agent through the OpenAI-compatible Responses API.

agentId.description: Local agent name or remote agent model ID.

prompt.description: Prompt to send to the agent.

filename.description: Optional exact name of a file in local file storage to attach.

background.description: Run asynchronously and return the background response object.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_list
local-skill-editor.title: List local skills for editing
local-skill-editor.description: List local Agent Skills that can be edited by the Skill Editor plugin.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_inspect
local-skill-editor.title: Inspect local skill package
local-skill-editor.description: Inspect a local Agent Skill manifest, files, versions, diagnostics, and body instructions.

skillId.description: Local skill id or skill name.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_create
local-skill-editor.title: Create local skill
local-skill-editor.description: Create a new local spec-compliant Agent Skill from scratch with a SKILL.md manifest.

name.description: Skill folder/name. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_update_manifest
local-skill-editor.title: Update local skill manifest
local-skill-editor.description: Update SKILL.md metadata and/or instructions. This creates a new incremented skill version and keeps previous versions readable/restorable.

skillId.description: Local skill id or skill name.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_upsert_file
local-skill-editor.title: Upsert local skill text file
local-skill-editor.description: Create or update a UTF-8 text file inside a local skill package in place. Use update_manifest for SKILL.md.

skillId.description: Local skill id or skill name.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type; defaults to text/plain.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_import_local_file
local-skill-editor.title: Import local file into skill
local-skill-editor.description: Copy an existing locally stored file, including PDFs or Office files, into a local skill package in place without conversion.

skillId.description: Local skill id or skill name.

localFileName.description: Exact local file name from the local files plugin.

relativePath.description: Destination path inside the skill package.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_delete_file
local-skill-editor.title: Delete local skill file
local-skill-editor.description: Delete a file from the current default version of a local skill package. SKILL.md cannot be deleted.

skillId.description: Local skill id or skill name.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_restore_version
local-skill-editor.title: Restore local skill version
local-skill-editor.description: Restore a previous local skill version by copying it into a new incremented version and making it default.

skillId.description: Local skill id or skill name.

local-skill-editor.name: local_skill_editor_delete_skill
local-skill-editor.title: Delete local skill
local-skill-editor.description: Delete an entire local skill package and all local versions.

skillId.description: Local skill id or skill name.
